topic: the statement proof must use the REGISTERED domain, not a hand-built stand-in
lesson: backend/src/warehouse/statement-projection.db.test.ts:205 fabricates its own statementDomain with measures: [] and dimensions: []. Since buildStatementProjection resolves selection.dimensionIds against domain.dimensions, 'leaf_key' finds nothing, includesLeaf is false, no GROUP BY is emitted and the proof gets ONE aggregate row instead of 81. The fix is not to patch the fake: import the REGISTERED statement domain from SemanticLayer (semanticLayer.ts declares goldObject statement_relation with dimensions leaf_key and month, and the statementMeasure entries) so the proof exercises the same domain the route does. This is the third time in this story a hand-built stand-in has drifted from the real thing and proved nothing - the selection with empty ids, and now the domain. A proof that builds its own version of the system under test proves only that its copy works.
